about: Setup snippets the API probe runs (inside the probed interpreter, stdlib-era syntax) before resolving symbols, so context-bound proxies such as flask.request resolve to real objects. Each snippet must work across the versions it names.

entries.code:
from flask import Flask
app = Flask('pymolt_probe')
app.add_url_rule('/x', 'x_ep', lambda: 'ok', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
ctx = app.test_request_context('/x?a=1', method='POST', json={'message': 'hi'}, headers={'Authorization': 'Basic dTpw'})
ctx.push()
entries.effect: pushes an app + request context so flask.request, flask.current_app, flask.g and flask.session resolve
